name: Light Streaks
description: The highlights of the first clip flare into long horizontal (or vertical) lens streaks while it smears with motion blur; at the peak the second clip takes over and its streaks shrink back into its highlights as it sharpens. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: reach
params.description: Length of the streaks at the peak, in frame widths

params.name: threshold
params.description: Brightness above which the picture flares

params.name: tint
params.description: Tint of the streaks, toward their ends

params.name: blur
params.description: Length of the motion blur at the peak
